zh-CN.title: 在线时不再误触发离线提醒
items: 打开应用或回到前台时立即更新在线状态
应用正在前台时不再重复弹出系统通知
自动清理当前设备已经失效的系统通知订阅

en.title: More accurate online notification routing
items: Online status now refreshes immediately when the app opens or returns to the foreground
System notifications no longer duplicate in-app alerts while the app is visible
Expired notification subscriptions on this device are now cleaned up automatically
